named_subject: a speedboat (motorboat hull with a cabin of small windows and spray lines at one end)
action: The boat launches up from the bank past the trees, travels through the air tilting, comes down stern-first onto the water, and then skims level across the lake.
identity_gap: The animated boat is a left-right mirror of the doodle with slightly smaller windows, but it keeps the same hull outline, three-window cabin and scribbled spray marks.
notes: The path, tilt and landing follow the film closely; the boat makes a large upward jump between frames 3 and 4 and a sudden change of tilt between frames 7 and 8. Adding in-between positions for those two steps would help most.
